test_objective: Check that you can create a context source registration that never expires

test_cases.name: 033_01_02 Create Context Source Registration That Never Expires
test_cases.doc: Check that you can create a context source registration that never expires
test_cases.then:
then {
    the SUT sends a valid Response for the operations:
        Create Context Source Registration With Return with Response Status Code set to 201     and
        Create Context Source Registration With Return with Response Header: Location containing $${registration_id}     and
        Retrieve Context Source Registration with Check Created Resource Set To and
            Query Parameter: 'ignored_keys' set to '${None}'
}
test_cases.when:
when {
    the SUT receives a Request from the client containing:
        URL set to '/ngsi-ld/v1/csourceRegistrations'
        method set to 'POST'
        Request Header['Content-Type'] set to 'application/ld+json' and
 payload defined in file: '${registration_payload}'
}
